svg.title: 46. Toe downward stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Sit with one foot supported on your opposite thigh. Hold the middle of the foot to keep the ankle still. Use the other hand to bend the toes gently downwards.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.whh.nhs.uk/media/5ndj32ll/ankle-range-of-motion-exercises-patient-advice-sheet.pdf
